propositions: scc_loc.analyze() invokes scc via subprocess with --format json flag, parses the two-level JSON structure (language groups containing per-file entries), and returns AnalyzerResult with loc payload keyed by repo-relative POSIX paths and max_loc field

When scc is unavailable (missing binary, non-zero exit, empty or unparseable JSON output), analyze() returns Unavailable with reason and _ACCRUING_SINCE, emits a warning, and never returns zero-filled results
analyze() accepts an injectable run parameter for testing; the default _run_scc shells out deterministically to scc with no cross-layer coupling to grounding._scc_files
Successful empty results (empty file list) return AnalyzerResult(loc={"files": {}, "max_loc": 0}), not Unavailable
Each file entry's Location is made repo-relative via os.path.relpath and normalized to POSIX format before use as a key in the loc["files"] dict

The scc_loc analyzer module is self-contained in src/rebar/metrics/analyzers/ and shares no code with the grounding layer, maintaining clean layering and deferring extraction to shared modules per YAGNI
